terms.comment: Traupman’s word, after Italian spaghetti, little strings. Not in Lewis & Short.

evidence: M-O s.v. pasta: spaghetti, after Vives, Exercitatio 353
terms.comment: Vives’s word for thin noodles, Spanish fideos (his editor’s note, via Morgan–Owens); classically little worms or grubs (Lucr. 2.899).

phrases.english: Twirl the spaghetti round your fork.

sources: Lewis & Short: vermiculus · Lewis & Short: convolvo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 383. Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. pasta: spaghetti. Levi–Bini has no word.
